title: Behind the scenes with an actor – B2 English Listening Test

seo.title: Behind the scenes with an actor – B2 English Listening Test - Test-English
seo.description: Test your B2 English listening skills with an actor's interview about his film. Watch the video, answer questions, and review the transcript!

parts:
B2 English Listening Test

Watch an interview with an actor about his latest film. For questions 1 to 7, choose the best answer (A, B, or C).
See the full list of B2 listening tests
Questions

questions.prompt: What do they say about the movie?

choices.html: The movie has been in cinemas for one week.
It has earned 100 million dollars in the US.
Jake was sure it would be a success.

questions.prompt: What does Jake say about the locations?

choices.html: The movie was shot in two main locations.
Some of the locations were dangerous.
It was tough to shoot in some of the locations.

questions.prompt: What does Jake say about his character?

choices.html: It's the most different character he's ever played.
He worked with the director to learn combat techniques.
The script helped him get into the role.

questions.prompt: What do they say about the cast?

choices.html: None of them were big stars, but they were all very talented.
Some actors gave better performances than others.
Some celebrities make brief appearances in the film.

questions.prompt: What does Jake say about the special effects?

choices.html: It wasn't easy to interact with things that weren't there.
They used AI to create the visuals.
The special effects were used to show his character's imagination.

questions.prompt: What do they say about the critics?

choices.html: Most reviews say it's a must-see film.
The film has received mixed reviews.
Jake doesn't agree with some of the reviews.

questions.prompt: Will there be a second part of this movie?

choices.html: Most likely, yes.
Probably not.
It depends.
